amends.reason: The preregistered 50-firm Haiku 4.5 extended-thinking pilot completed all 150 requests with zero translational failures and materially improved raw-coordinate L1 compliance relative to the frozen non-thinking Haiku arm, but failed the unchanged feasibility gates because aggregate compliance was 0.8867 and C4R compliance was 0.7800. This amendment authorizes one full 575-firm characterization run to estimate contract feasibility and condition-specific failure rates precisely. It does not preregister a directional performance conclusion and does not permit threshold relaxation, post-hoc rescaling, or inclusion in the primary matched-inference cohort when the strict gates fail.
amends.preservation_rule: Do not overwrite, resume, relabel, or pool the 50-firm pilot with the 575-firm full characterization run.

provider_contract.thinking_content_storage: Thinking blocks are excluded from Stage7 raw output and checkpoints; only non-secret counts and token usage metadata are retained.
provider_contract.stop_reason_policy: max_tokens and model_context_window_exceeded are hard provider failures and must not enter the action parser.

decision_rules.primary_feasibility_pass: All row-completeness and parser gates pass, translational failures equal zero, aggregate raw-coordinate L1 compliance is at least 0.95, and every condition-specific compliance rate is at least 0.90.
decision_rules.primary_feasibility_fail: Any unchanged feasibility gate fails. Report the observed failure rate and condition localization; do not relax gates or reclassify clipped downstream actions as compliant.
decision_rules.performance_claim_if_pass: When the strict feasibility gates pass, compare Oracle outcomes to the frozen GPT-5.4-mini and Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite cohorts using the same 0.75 contract, while retaining backend-specific inference and no pooling.
decision_rules.performance_claim_if_fail: When the strict feasibility gates fail, the confirmatory conclusion is provider-protocol contract infeasibility. Stage8 and Stage9 outcomes may be reported only as exploratory post-translation or post-clipping descriptions and must not support a confirmatory claim that Haiku is intrinsically lower-performing.
decision_rules.directional_outcome_precommitment: No directional superiority or inferiority conclusion is preregistered.

stopping_rule: Run exactly one fresh 575-firm extended-thinking characterization cohort. Preserve the archive and QC ledger whether the gate passes or fails. Do not launch another Haiku amendment based on this result within the thesis analysis freeze.
interpretation_boundary: The full run characterizes one frozen Haiku 4.5 provider protocol under IC-b and the raw-coordinate L1 contract. It tests contract feasibility more precisely; it cannot by design prove that the Haiku model family is universally inferior. Temperature remains omitted because extended thinking is incompatible with custom temperature, so comparison to the legacy temperature-zero non-thinking run is protocol-level rather than a pure reasoning treatment.
